proposal.summary: Path traversal vulnerability in AVEVA InTouch Access Anywhere Secure Gateway 2020 R2 and older allows reading arbitrary files via crafted GET requests.
proposal.affected_product: Access Anywhere Secure Gateway versions 2020 R2 and older

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerability by reproducing the GET request against a test instance, identify all accessible filesystem paths, and implement input validation/normalization to prevent ../ encoded traversals or apply path canonicalization and access controls. Coordinate disclosure and prepare patch or mitigation guidance.
